images.prompt: Exact side view cross-section: one ATP synthase standing in a horizontal deep-teal thylakoid membrane. In the membrane its amber ring (CF0) of fourteen identical subunits like the staves of a barrel; on the right of the ring the amber 'a' subunit with a narrow channel, joined to a thin amber side arm that rises and holds the top of the head. Below the membrane the pale-gold lumen crowded with many small glowing white protons; above it the ivory stroma with only a few. The machine fills the centre third of the width.
